Tokentrim Pro Discount for Early Buyers

You can get Tokentrim Pro for a one-time payment of $49, but only if you are one of the first 500 buyers. Tokentrim Pro offers a hosted dashboard on any device, Monday digest, weekly budget with alert at 80%, and Slack totals.

What is Tokentrim Pro

Tokentrim Pro is an upgrade to the free version of Tokentrim. It adds features like a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, and weekly budget with alert.

Features of Tokentrim Pro

Tokentrim Pro includes a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, weekly budget with alert at 80%, and Slack totals. You can use it on up to 3 machines.

Benefits of Tokentrim Pro

The full install of Tokentrim cut history re-read by 75% and made limits last 4.0x longer for the author's 135 conversations. Shrinking tool output alone saved 6.9%. The billed cost fell roughly 55-70%.

FAQ

What is the cost of Tokentrim Pro? The cost is $49 once for the first 500 buyers, or $9/month. How does Tokentrim Pro help with budgeting? Tokentrim Pro offers a weekly budget with alert at 80%, helping you stay on top of your token usage. Is my data secure with Tokentrim Pro? Yes, nothing leaves your machine by default.
